title: Parity-induced generalized Brillouin zone without non-Hermitian skin effect
summary: Acute spectral sensitivity to boundary conditions and the formation of a generalized Brillouin zone associated with complex quasimomenta are features frequently attributed to systems with non-trivial non-Hermitian topology, showcasing the non-Hermitian skin effect. We show that, away from the thermodynamic limit, these features themselves are not uniquely tied to this phenomenon; they can similarly arise as parity-induced even-odd effects in non-Hermitian systems without skin effect.
